subject: A field of floating slabs, one row per conductor along the span, whose heights are the standing wave the wind locks into each wire, drawn as a patent figure between two cross-arms cut in hatched section.
controls: wind: shape (heights) — the locked mode number climbs from one broad hump at 0.5 m/s to fine loops at 20 m/s, so the crests multiply along every row.
span: count — the field grows from 10 to 18 slabs along the line while the cross-arms move apart, and the same wind sings a higher mode on a longer span.
gust: shape (row offset) — neighbouring modes join the lock and each row drifts out of step with the next, so the crests stop lining up across the conductors.
hum: shape (texture) — a fine alternating mains ripple lifts every other slab by up to 8 px, an even comb under the wind's loops; none at 0.
risks: Closest to toro's voice field in build (it's the same pattern), so it has to earn its difference in the drawing: hatched section plates and patent numerals, hidden-line slabs, no solid grey faces. At span 100 it's 90 slabs × 3 nodes = 270 nodes, over 256, so it needs sdk 1.8 or a row fewer. Wind, gust and hum all act on heights; hum's comb has to stay visibly a texture rather than another wave, or it reads as a second wind. Crest highlight is several cells, so the 'one brightest element' is a set, not a single part.
